subject: Prompt/output/log purge request — certification & timelines
messages:
From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@stellarhealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Stellar Health Security <security@stellarhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Purge of prompts/outputs/logs for tenant st-9832

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for taking this. We need a formal purge (prompts, model outputs, kv/embedding indices, and inference logs) scoped to our tenant (st-9832). The compliance team requires:

- A clear step-by-step runbook for the purge (including any TTL-based delayed deletion)
- Expected ETA for completion and proof of deletion artifacts (manifest or signed certificate)
- Confirmation of backups/snapshots that will be retained vs. deleted, and retention window for backups
- Whether embedded model caches / KV caches will be expunged or only rotated

Can you confirm the timeline and send the template/manifest you will provide once complete? We need this to satisfy a QSA audit later this month.

Alex
Alex Wu
Security Engineer, Stellar Health

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@stellarhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Nov 2028 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Purge of prompts/outputs/logs for tenant st-9832

Alex — thanks for the detail. High level answer up front: we can perform a scoped purge that covers prompts, generated outputs, inference telemetry logs, embeddings indices, and KV cache entries tied to st-9832. Below I outline the workflow, expected dates, and proof artifacts.

Planned purge workflow (high level):
1) Intake & verification (today): validate the tenant id, authorized signatory, and whether any legal holds apply.
2) Freeze & snapshot (T+0): create a locked snapshot of current state for internal audit; snapshots are marked for deletion per your instruction and documented in the manifest.
3) Execute deletion (T+1 business day): run targeted eviction against prompt and KV stores, remove embeddings indexes for tenant namespace, and truncate inference logs older than configured retention that are tenant-specific.
4) Backups: identify any independent backups (S3/glacier/hypervisor-level). By default we flag backups for retention but can schedule their purge on request — this is an extra step that requires signed approval.
5) Post-run verification (T+1 to T+2): run verification checks, compile `erase_manifest_v1.csv` detailing object ids, commit hashes, log IDs removed, and a checksum list.
6) Certificate delivery (T+2): deliver a signed `erasure_certificate_*.pdf` and optional DocuSign acknowledgement for your records.

Key constraints and notes:
- ETA: if we receive signed approval by EOD today (11/15), we can execute deletion 11/16 and deliver artifacts by 11/16 afternoon PST.
- Backups: snapshot deletion is a separate action. We will not delete cross-region long-term backups without explicit authorization from Stellar (signed mailbox or DocuSign).
- KV/Embeddings: KV cache entries and embedding indices for the tenant will be evicted; ephemeral caches used for inference may be garbage-collected sooner. Persistent embedding indices are removed from the index namespace and a manifest entries the index shards removed.

Attachments: I’m attaching a sample manifest template we will populate as we execute.

Next steps for you: please confirm (A) authorized approver (name + email), and (B) whether you want us to purge associated backups, or merely mark them for future deletion.

—
Sofia Ivanova
Manager, Customer Ops — Redwood Inference
Sofia will be the point of contact for the run and will coordinate with Ops to schedule the job.

Attachments: erase_manifest_template.csv (CSV stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Alex Wu <alex.wu@stellarhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Nov 2028 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Purge of prompts/outputs/logs for tenant st-9832

Alex / Sofia — ops notes and execution checklist below. We will follow Sofia's high-level plan and I’ll run the job once we receive the signed approval.

Execution checklist (detailed):
- Pre-run: confirm legal hold via one-line signed email (approver: Maya Reynolds, Stellar Health Legal).
- Pre-run: create timestamped snapshot (snap-20281115-st-9832) and log snapshot manifest into internal ticket REDW-ERASE-9721.
- Run: execute eviction script with tenant filter = st-9832.
  - Command: `redwood-purge --tenant st-9832 --scope prompts,outputs,embeddings,kv,logs --commit`
  - Safety: non-destructive dry-run to list objects first; then commit window of 30 minutes for rollback.
- Backup handling: check S3 lifecycle objects with tag tenant=st-9832. If you request full backup purge, we will schedule a second job (requires explicit signed consent).
- Verification: run `redwood-verifier --manifest erase_manifest_v1.csv --verify-checksums` and collect verification log `verify_log_20281116.txt`.
- Certificate: generate `erasure_certificate_stellar_20281116.pdf`, sign with Operations key, attach to ticket and email.

ETA: With approval received this morning, we will do the dry-run at 09:30 PST and commit by 11:00 PST on 11/16. Complete artifacts (manifest + verify_log + signed certificate) delivered same day. If you want backup purges, that pushes the final delivery by 24–48 hours.

Attachments: none in this message. I will attach verification logs and certificate after run.

Marissa
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@stellarhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Nov 2028 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Purge of prompts/outputs/logs for tenant st-9832

Alex — job completed and artifacts attached below. Thank you for the quick turnaround and for confirming approver Maya Reynolds via the signed email earlier today.

Summary of actions performed:
- Dry run produced 12,438 artifact rows (listed in `erase_manifest_v1.csv`).
- Committed deletion window executed at 11:03 PST. No rollbacks performed during the 30-minute commit window.
- Removed: prompt blobs (namespace st-9832/prompts/*), generated outputs (st-9832/outputs/*), embeddings shards (st-9832/embeddings/shard-4..shard-7), KV entries (kv://st-9832/*), tenant-scoped inference logs (logid 9876500-9877543).
- Snapshot `snap-20281115-st-9832` retained until explicit backup purge authorization. Snapshot id and storage location are in the manifest.
- Verification: `verify_log_20281116.txt` indicates successful checksum matches for deleted objects and records the deletions (timestamped).

Attached: erasure_certificate_stellar_20281116.pdf (signed), erase_manifest_v1.csv (CSV with object ids), verify_log_20281116.txt (plaintext verification output).

If you'd like a DocuSign acknowledgement for records, here's an embedded link: https://docusign.com/embeddedSigning?token=abc123

Ben Carter
Head of Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
